name: A Land Filled with Hatred

faq.answer: Loh'atu is stationed on the border of Ashenvale, watching over the edge of the woods and sending travelers to strike down the corrupted satyr nearby.
The Haldarr satyr dwell in the corrupted woods near the border of Ashenvale.
faq.q: Where are the Haldarr satyr found?

faq.answer: He has sworn an oath to the Earthmother to aid the night elves in ridding the land of the demonic satyr.
faq.q: Why does Loh'atu want the Haldarr satyr slain?

sections.body: Corrupted fiends prowl near the frontier, sending out tricksters and felsworn to terrorize the surrounding forest. Loh'atu waits at the edge of the wilderness for word that their ranks have been broken, bound by an oath to the Earthmother to aid the night elves.
sections.title: A Watch on the Border

summary: Loh'atu watches the border of Ashenvale, where violent satyr threaten anyone crossing between the lands. He asks you to strike deep into the Haldarr encampments to blunt their aggression.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Land Filled with Hatred
